caption:
EMA 20 crossed EMA 50. Does that automatically mean buy? No.

The 20-period exponential moving average reacts faster to recent prices than the 50-period EMA. A cross may help describe momentum, but both averages use past prices and lag. Sideways markets can produce repeated whipsaws. Check broader structure and risk before interpreting the chart.
